Two portals give access to the CorkLab data explorer:

- [Public data explorer](https://corklab.cmaslard.xyz/): open access.
- [Private data explorer](https://private-corklab.cmaslard.xyz/): access restricted (Cloudflare Access). Use your authorized email to receive a one-time login code. If you don't receive a code within \~60 seconds, your email is likely not allow-listed; please contact me.

This is a side project, similar in spirit to the VermeerLab portal: it centralizes shared Shiny tools and resources for exploring the lab's data.
